name: Ricardo "Ric" Alonzo
office: City of Montebello, Member of the City Council, 5th District

items.text: Ricardo “Ric” Alonzo is an aerospace engineer appointed to the Montebello City Council District 5 seat in January 2025. He was appointed with only two council members present. In March 2026, he voted against a housing rezoning ordinance, which failed 2-3. His campaign says he voted to keep AI data centers out of Montebello and to fund a $50,000 family relief program.

He was appointed with only two council members present.
In March 2026, he voted against a housing rezoning ordinance, which failed 2-3.

items.text: His campaign lists accomplishments including a police and community resource center on the south side, more repaved streets, renovated park restrooms, and the Chet Holifield community garden, accepted as complete in September 2026.
